newsitem.title: USA: Dart Container president ups Allou stake.
newsitem.headline: Dart Container president ups Allou stake.

text.p: Kenneth Dart, president of Dart Container Corp, said Thursday he raised his stake in Allou Health & Beauty Care Inc to 7.98 percent or 363,100 common shares.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Dart said he bought through his company Ross Financial Corp, 55,000 additional shares of Allou between February 5 and February 24 at prices ranging from $6.313 to $6.725 a share.
Dart and Ross Financial hold the stake as a long-term passive investment, the filing said.
